summary: One client on LTP and another on Quote for the same instrument: the desktop moves Pocketful to detailed data and serves both; the web publishes the detailed packet on the LTP topic, so its Quote client starves.

notes: Found by this lane, not in the audit (PF-03).

deviations.reason: Pocketful sends the last trade time in epoch seconds and the web passes the seconds on as ltt; the desktop sends epoch milliseconds, the unit the docs give every WebSocket time (decisions 2026-11-09: ltt in seconds -> ms, a web defect, wrong unit).

The desktop sends Pocketful's change key from LTP up (names.rs `from`), in Quote and Depth frames too; the Pocketful web adapter sends change only in its LTP (compact) frame. Open until wire's WebName.to.

With an LTP and a Quote subscriber on one instrument, the web's _find_subscription returns the first subscription (the LTP one) for every packet, so the detailed packet goes out on the LTP topic and the Quote subscriber gets nothing at all (PF-03). The desktop serves both.

The web publishes the detailed packet on the LTP topic (PF-03), so its LTP client gets the whole Quote dict; the desktop's LTP frame from a Quote packet carries the LTP keys. Open until wire's C08 one-dict fold (lower-mode frames of one-dict brokers carry the richer packet's keys as the web sends them), which decides what this frame carries.
